speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development whether there are plans to increase the offering of non-Chinese official languages as a mother tongue language at the preschool and kindergarten levels for MOE-registered institutions located within Sengkang Town.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: The Government has been working to increase the offering of Mother Tongue Language (MTL) at preschools.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: All Ministry of Education (MOE) Kindergartens offer all three MTLs.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: However, the increase in provision of MTL requires time as the number of MTL teachers is limited.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: We have at least one preschool centre offering Malay or Tamil language in almost all heartland planning areas.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: ECDA will continue to work with the AOPs to ensure a good geographical spread of centres offering MTL.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: To expand MTL teaching resources, ECDA has been working closely with training providers and operators to expand training capacity.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: For example, we introduced the Certificate in Preschool MTL Teaching (CPMTL) for Malay and Tamil Language in 2019 and have progressively increased the number of training places since then.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: While ECDA continues to ramp up the supply of MTL teachers, preschools may determine their provision of MTL according to the needs and preferences of children and parents in each locality.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: ECDA's continued efforts to expand the provision of MTL, together with MOE's planned increase in the number of MOE Kindergartens, will offer parents a wider range of preschools that offer MTL learning.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: I noted as well that she shared that there were quite a large number of these MTL facilities located within the Sengkang planning area, I believe, were her words.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: Based on my background research online at the MOE portal, I was actually able to establish that within Sengkang Town, meaning Sengkang GRC, it currently only has nine institutions offering Chinese MTL, versus 12 in nearby Punggol.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: And four offering Malay, versus seven, in Punggol.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: This is despite the slightly larger population within Sengkang GRC.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: So, I am wondering if this is a function of the planning radius, like what the Minister of State described, or is it a difference in demographics that accounts for these differences?

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: If there is a need for a further clarification of these numbers, I would be happy to take this up with the Member offline.

speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan (Aljunied)
text: I did ask a question about Mother Tongue Language education teachers in the Early Childhood level and the question was "what was the breakdown in the number of MTL preschool educators".

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: And this was already announced by the Ministry of Social and Family Development and ECDA in 2018.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: I would also like to clarify that the Member had referred to MOE.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: I think there is a need for us to distinguish between MOE Kindergartens and childcare centres.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: So, as I mentioned in my main reply, all MOE Kindergartens offer all three Mother Tongue Languages.
